nativeHost.failure: Actual public CLI with retained predecessor featureless release refused plain-sparse-chat-text as model_choices_unsupported. Named stream remains in current resource.

sharedParserInitialValues.failure: Actual freshly built previous shared parser returned complete. instead of Native complete. because initial block text was discarded. Explicit original assertion retained.

sharedParserPartialUsage.failure: Exact predecessor mjs parser with current emitted relative dependencies produced input12/output0/cache0 for prompt_tokens12 with no completion dimension, expected null. Development-only temporary dist module was hash-checked and removed after capture; no network/auth/user data.

change.module: Private Qoder Shape normalizes sparse Chat/index defaults, nested content/reasoning aliases, stable repeated IDs, provisional final tool names and sparse content-block streams into the same bounded Chat decoder. Qoder HTTP/auth dialect and selected model do not change. Each physical stream owns its state.
change.completion: Only actual DONE or message_stop can finalize. Block closure, typed object/JSON arguments, contiguous bounded tool identities, limits, explicit non-truncating reason and both envelope error layers still gate exposure. Missing finish_reason can be inferred from validated calls only at that physical terminal. EOF, length/max_tokens, malformed/mixed/duplicate/unfinished blocks never become calls.
change.usage: Repeated usage is one physical request: latest complete observation wins, a later partial cannot erase known amounts, incomplete alone remains unknown and explicit zeros remain quantities. Chat input/output aliases normalize through the existing accounting seam. Anthropic-only partial fields do not become Chat billing zero.
change.sharedReferenceFix: Shared TS parser now preserves initial text/thinking/tool input, recognizes input/output aliases and refuses to fabricate a missing dimension as zero. Same53 generated actual parser cases also validate the native decoder. No extra Agent loop, provider request, execution path or engine sidecar.
change.limits: Existing8MiB response/1MiB event decode and bounded nodes/depth;512KiB text/thinking,64KiB tool arguments,32 tools and128 blocks. No new dependencies. Calls remain model intent until existing Host Projection/Grant/Provider/Evidence execution.

nativeDecoder.coverage: Both envelope/plain sparse Chat and blocks, six thinking aliases, Unicode/grapheme text, initial values, provisional names/null placeholders, multiple tools, repeated/progressive/partial usage; malformed scalar/shape/closed/index/mixed/size and missing terminal refuse without calls.

Six invalid flows preserve known fees or unknown, produce no tool effect, and admit a later independent task without changing old history. Exact group members retained, original owned group and fixture executables later absent; fixtures/effects/unknown records preserved. Fresh final gate used separate roots.

existingStateRecovery.current: Error/truncated flows retain observed known fees or unknown, no partial tool dispatch, old history preserved and later tasks verified. Existing native recover/ledger/compaction/MCP ownership tests remain in the final gate.
existingStateRecovery.legacy: No personal old records were inspected. A previously persisted zero cannot be distinguished from a coerced missing dimension using a ledger row alone. Do not guess/rewrite old billing or history; authoritative original provider usage/trace is required for reconciliation. Automatic retroactive repair was not implemented or claimed.
